notes.title: A Great Launch and Known Bugs
notes.notes:
Hey all,

Thank you for a great launch of the game! I hope your enjoying Shift Orb.

I'm aware of a few glaring bugs with the current build, including the mouse cursor not showing up on the main menu without a controller plugged in. As a work around, you can use the up, down, and return key to make your selections.

I'll have a fix for this soon.

If you have any bugs to report, you're encouraged to leave them in the discussions forum.
